svg.title: The mean trip and one trip for the commute case
svg.desc: A narrow normal posterior for the mean commute time beside a much wider normal predictive distribution for a single trip, with both intervals drawn beneath.
svg.text: The average trip and tomorrow's trip
sixteen trips, mean 27.5 minutes, trip-to-trip spread sigma equals 8 minutes
95 percent credible interval for mu: 24.21 to 31.48
95 percent predictive interval for one trip: 11.75 to 43.94
Both are centred on 27.845 minutes. The wider band is not a worse result; it answers a different
